definitions.explanation: A person sent on a specific diplomatic or official mission, typically by a head of state or government. Distinguished from a regular ambassador by the temporary and focused nature of the assignment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大統領|だいとうりょう}→大統領：03418_daitouryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{特使|とくし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The president dispatched a special envoy.

examples.japanese: {和平|わへい}⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{特使|とくし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: A special envoy headed to the region for peace negotiations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気候|きこう}{変動|へんどう}→気候変動：04627_kikouhendou⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{特使|とくし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{任命|にんめい}→任命：09764_ninmei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The prime minister appointed a special envoy in charge of climate change issues.

notes:
A compound of {特|とく} (special) and {使|し} (envoy, messenger). Frequently appears in news reporting about international diplomacy. The word implies a person given a specific, often urgent, mandate rather than a standing diplomatic role.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {特使|とくし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dispatch a special envoy
- {特使|とくし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{任命|にんめい}→任命：09764_ninmei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to appoint a special envoy
- ⟦{大統領|だいとうりょう}→大統領：03418_daitouryou⟧{特使|とくし}: presidential special envoy
- {和平|わへい}{特使|とくし}: peace envoy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大使|たいし}→大使：03391_taishi⟧: ambassador — a permanent diplomatic representative stationed in a foreign country
- ⟦{使節|しせつ}→使節：11694_shisetsu⟧: envoy, delegate — a broader term for someone sent on an official mission; can refer to a delegation
- ⟦{公使|こうし}→公使：15564_koushi⟧: minister (diplomatic) — a diplomatic representative ranking below ambassador
